name: Alan Ó Cinnéide
title: Senior Technical Lead
profile: Creative technical lead specializing in quality software solutions for digital audio problems. Passionate about communication, collaboration and learning.
experience: Providing software development services to clients.
Contributing to Zoundio’s product portfolio, most notably the Gibson App on iOS and Android. Working remotely from The Hague.
Contributed to the product development and technology team, particularly in Active Noise Cancellation and biometric sensing.
Developed audio signal processing solutions for spatial audio and speaker protection as part of Huawei’s audio research team.
Led a cross-functional research and development scrum team, delivering software for the amplifier business unit and contributing to several design-wins of Tier 1 and midrange vendors.

Designed and delivered electrical engineering courses, including Engineering Mathematics, Analog and Digital Electronics, and Digital Signal Processing, as a member of the Systems Engineering department.
Developed audio signal processing solutions as part of NXP’s Audio Acoustic Laboratory, including Loudspeaker Protection for Mobile Audio and Error Concealment for Automotive Audio.
education: Completed a doctoral degree as part of DIT’s Audio Research Group. Thesis: Phase-Distortion Robust Voice Source Analysis.
